name: Code
description: Improve behavior without breaking what works.
goal: Increase edge-case correctness while preserving the public API.
score: Fraction of development behaviors that pass (0–1).
gates: Existing regression suite passes; public API and assertion count preserved.
feedback: Name the failed behavior, observed output and expected contract; avoid literal answers.
details: Preserve public behavior and compatibility. Improve one general mechanism per candidate. Hold back fresh edge cases outside the repository.

name: Performance
goal: Reduce median runtime on representative workloads without changing outputs.
score: Negative median runtime in milliseconds, so faster is a higher score.
gates: Output equivalence, memory ceiling and all regression checks pass.
feedback: Report timing distribution and the slow operation, with workload characteristics.
details: Profile first. Preserve outputs. Keep graders serial; set minimum gain above the measured baseline noise floor. Use unseen workload sizes for holdout.

name: Prompts
description: Improve instructions on fresh, diverse cases.
goal: Increase task success across representative and adversarial inputs with concise instructions.
score: Task success fraction on fixed representative cases, with pinned model and settings.
gates: Output schema, instruction hierarchy, evidence honesty and token ceiling pass.
feedback: Report failure categories and supporting output excerpts, not target answers.
details: Version the rubric and pin model/settings. Separate development and unseen case families. Prefer operational instructions over persona or extra scaffolding. Repeat stochastic model evaluations; account for evaluator usage separately.

name: Writing
description: Sharpen clarity while keeping facts intact.
goal: Make the document clearer and more useful for its intended reader while preserving supported claims.
score: Anchored rubric for reader comprehension, specificity and usefulness.
gates: Factual claims trace to supplied sources; required content and constraints preserved.
feedback: Identify confusing passages, unsupported claims and missing reader decisions.
details: Specify reader, purpose, voice and source material. Combine mechanical checks with a versioned rubric and blind repeated judgments. Fresh readers/questions form holdout. Uncalibrated judgments are exploratory evidence.

name: Design
description: Improve a file-backed interface or visual artifact.
goal: Improve clarity and task completion at desktop and mobile widths.
score: Behavioral task success plus an anchored visual rubric on fixed screenshots.
gates: Keyboard access, contrast, no overflow, no missing assets and working interactions.
feedback: Point to the surface, user task and observed visual or interaction failure.
details: Capture real rendering at 1280 and 390 wide. Preserve product behavior. Evaluate revealing empty/error/long-content states. Use fresh viewport/state combinations for holdout. Generators need local assets; candidate network is disabled.

name: Configuration
goal: Improve throughput under a fixed resource budget without reducing reliability.
score: Throughput on representative workloads (higher is better).
gates: Schema, resource ceilings, timeout limits and reliability checks pass.
feedback: Report the bottleneck, load characteristics and violated operating constraint.
details: Bound each tunable value. Keep measurement settings fixed and graders serial for shared resources. Use unseen load patterns for holdout. Never exercise production services during a local experiment.
